id.about.offline: Panel ini tidak pernah melakukan request jaringan otomatis — font dan ikonnya ditanam di dalam filenya. Tautan di sini cuma terbuka kalau kamu sendiri yang mengkliknya.

id.setup.commit.hint: Biarkan kosong kalau mau coba dulu.
id.setup.done: Selesai. Buka editor dan lanjut kerja seperti biasa — AI sekarang membaca aturan design system otomatis.
id.setup.done.sub: Nggak perlu dipasang lagi. Kalau mau naik level atau memperbaiki pemasangan, ada di bawah.
id.setup.done.title: Design system sudah terpasang
id.setup.l1code.copied: Alamat email disalin — kalau draf email tidak terbuka, tempel saja
id.setup.l1code.hint: Level 1 menyentuh 2 baris config build, jadi perlu persetujuan pemelihara design system.
id.setup.l1why.d: Satu baris preset di tailwind.config.js, satu baris import CSS di nuxt.config.js. Dua-duanya diberi penanda dan tercatat di struk, jadi bisa dicabut lagi kapan pun tanpa nyentuh baris punyamu.
id.setup.lead: Bukan installer — ini versi terpandu dari tutorial resmi. Rencana lengkap selalu tampil sebelum apa pun dijalankan.
id.setup.level0.desc: Tanpa risiko. Grounding AI aktif, build tidak disentuh.
id.setup.level1.desc: Menambah 2 baris ke config. Token live + dark mode. Perlu kode akses.
id.setup.next.done.d: Level 1 aktif: grounding AI jalan dan class token bisa dipakai. Dari sini tinggal pantau kesehatannya dan pakai pustaka prompt.
id.setup.next.l1.d: Sekarang di Level 0 — AI-nya sudah paham design system, tapi class token belum bisa dipakai di kode. Level 1 menambah 2 baris bertanda untuk mengaktifkannya.
id.setup.reinstall.hint: Formulirnya sama. Tetap plan-first: rencananya ditampilkan dulu, dan apa pun yang diganti disalin lebih dulu ke .ds/.trash/.
id.setup.repoUrl.hint: Bisa diganti ke repo mana pun yang berisi design system ini.
id.setup.title: Pasang design system
id.status.healthy: Sehat — tidak ada yang perlu ditangani
id.tour.about.d: Penjelasan singkat tiga lapisnya, info build, lisensi font dan ikon, plus kontak pemeliharanya kalau ada yang mau ditanyakan.
id.tour.adoption.d: Berapa repo yang sudah pakai, berapa kali dipasang, di-update, di-uninstall, dan berapa yang masih tertinggal versi. Semuanya dihitung dari struk yang ter-commit, tanpa telemetri.
id.tour.docs.d: Galeri komponen dibuka di tab baru. Dokumen dirender di sini — ada tab Pratinjau dan Markdown, dan tombol × buat menutupnya.
id.tour.finish.a: Mulai dari Pasang → Level 0. Bisa dibatalkan dalam satu langkah.
id.tour.finish.b: Ragu soal sesuatu? Buka Dokumen — SAFETY mendaftar tiap file yang disentuh.
id.tour.finish.banner: Tur selesai — nggak ada yang diubah
id.tour.finish.c: Mau lihat tur ini lagi: menu ⋯ → Putar tour.
id.tour.finish.d: Nggak ada yang berubah di repo kamu dari tur ini. Tiap aksi tetap nanya dulu.
id.tour.health.d: Panel menyadarinya, menunjukkan diff-nya, lalu menawarkan dua jalan: kembalikan ke template, atau kirim perubahannya ke desainer supaya masuk rilis berikutnya. Doctor juga di sini — read-only, cuma lapor.
id.tour.hero.d: Sekali lihat: terpasang atau belum, level adopsinya, versi design system, dan commit yang di-pin. Di bawahnya daftar hal yang perlu ditindak, kalau ada.
id.tour.lang.d: Ganti ID/EN kapan saja — seluruh panel ikut, termasuk pesan dari server. Pilihanmu diingat.
id.tour.level.d: Level 0 nggak nyentuh build kamu sama sekali — yang didapat cuma pemahaman AI dan galeri. Level 1 baru menambah 2 baris bertanda supaya class token bisa dipakai. Perbandingannya ada di bawah pilihan ini.
id.tour.more.d: Versi panel, putar ulang tur ini, ganti tema terang/gelap, dan tutup panel (itu menghentikan servernya juga).
id.tour.nav.d: Tujuh tujuan, mengapung di bawah biar nggak makan tempat. Titik kuning di sebuah ikon berarti bagian itu perlu kamu lihat.
id.tour.process.d: Dia menampilkan rencana lengkap dulu: tiap perintah, isi tiap file, dan daftar apa yang TIDAK disentuh. Ikon mata di tiap langkah buat lihat isinya sebelum setuju.
id.tour.prompts.d: Prompt yang sudah membawa aturan repo ini dan level adopsinya. Isi kolomnya, salin, tempel ke AI agent kamu — nggak perlu jelasin design system dari nol tiap sesi.
id.tour.stats.d: Token, spec, file reference, dan katalog AI. Angkanya dibaca langsung dari folder yang terpasang, jadi nggak mungkin basi.
id.tour.versions.d: Sebelum update, panel menghitung dampaknya: token apa yang hilang dan file kamu mana yang memakainya. Titik rollback dicatat otomatis, jadi selalu ada jalan pulang.
id.tour.video.banner: Paling enak ditonton dulu — setelah ini semuanya masuk akal
id.tour.video.soon.d: Tur di bawah sudah cukup untuk mulai. Videonya muncul sendiri begitu filenya ada di repo design system.
id.tour.welcome.d: Panel ini yang menyambungkan design system ke repo kamu. Tonton penjelasan singkatnya dulu, habis itu aku tunjukkan bagian-bagiannya satu per satu.
id.tour.welcome.t: Kenalan dulu sama design system ini
id.ver.impact.none: Tidak ada token atau spec yang dihapus. Aman.
id.ver.lead: Lihat dampaknya dulu, baru update. Selalu bisa dikembalikan.
id.ver.noRollback: Belum ada titik rollback — muncul otomatis setelah update pertama.
id.ver.rollback.hint: Kembali ke versi design system sebelumnya.

en.about.author: Author & maintainer
en.about.bind.d: .ds/bindings.md maps each spec to this repo's own components. You keep owning your components.
en.about.lead: A design system that never injects code. One source of visual truth, shared by humans and AI agents.
en.about.offline: This panel never makes an automatic network request — its fonts and icons are embedded in the file itself. The links here only open if you click them yourself.
en.about.ref.d: Plain HTML+CSS components you open in a browser — what designers look at and AI agents read.
en.about.title: About
en.about.truth.d: Tokens and component specs in the design system repo, compiled and validated on every release.
en.adopt.me.hint: Only actions from your git account, matched through a non-identifying hash. Your address is not stored anywhere.
en.adopt.noteam: Team numbers are not available in this installed design system version.
en.adopt.org.hint: Every registered repo, counted from committed receipts. Cumulative — these do not reset when the design system updates.
en.adopt.repo.hint: This repo's history, whoever did it. Append-only and committed, so it survives updates and uninstalls alike.
en.adopt.title: Adoption statistics
en.adopt.unconfigured: No repos are registered in the report yet, so team numbers are still zero. That is the design system maintainer's job, not yours.

en.attn.halfwired.title: Level 1 is half-wired

en.setup.l1why.d: One preset line in tailwind.config.js, one CSS import line in nuxt.config.js. Both are marked and recorded in the receipt, so either can be pulled back out later without touching a line of yours.
en.setup.lead: Not an installer — a guided version of the official tutorial. You always see the full plan before anything runs.
en.setup.level0.desc: Zero risk. AI grounding on, build untouched.
en.setup.level1.desc: Adds 2 lines to your config. Live tokens + dark mode. Needs an access code.

en.setup.next.l1.d: You are on Level 0 — the AI already understands the design system, but token classes are not usable in code yet. Level 1 adds 2 marked lines to turn them on.

en.setup.title: Install the design system
en.tour.about.d: A short explanation of the three layers, build details, font and icon licences, and the maintainer's contact if something needs asking.
en.tour.adoption.d: How many repos adopted it, how many installs, updates and uninstalls, and how many are behind. All counted from committed receipts, with no telemetry.
en.tour.docs.d: The component gallery opens in a new tab. Documents render here — with Preview and Markdown tabs, and an × to close.
en.tour.finish.a: Start at Setup → Level 0. Reversible in one step.
en.tour.finish.b: Unsure about something? Open Documents — SAFETY lists every file touched.
en.tour.finish.c: To see this tour again: the ⋯ menu → Play tour.
en.tour.finish.d: Nothing in your repo changed from this tour. Every action still asks first.
en.tour.health.d: The panel notices, shows the diff, then offers two ways out: restore the template, or send the change to the designer so it lands in the next release. Doctor lives here too — read-only, it only reports.
en.tour.health.t: If someone edits a managed file
en.tour.hero.d: At a glance: installed or not, adoption level, design system version, and the pinned commit. Below it, anything that needs acting on.
en.tour.lang.d: Switch ID/EN whenever — the whole panel follows, including messages from the server. Your choice is remembered.
en.tour.level.d: Level 0 does not touch your build at all — you get AI understanding and the gallery. Level 1 adds 2 marked lines so token classes become usable. The comparison sits right under the choice.
en.tour.more.d: Panel version, replay this tour, switch between light and dark, and close the panel — which stops the server too.
en.tour.nav.d: Seven destinations, floating at the bottom so they cost no space. A yellow dot on an icon means that section needs your attention.
en.tour.process.d: It shows the full plan first: every command, every file's contents, and a list of what is NOT touched. The eye icon on a step previews its contents before you agree.
en.tour.process.t: This button does not run anything yet
en.tour.prompts.d: Prompts that already carry this repo's rules and adoption level. Fill the fields, copy, paste into your AI agent — no explaining the design system from scratch every session.
en.tour.stats.d: Tokens, specs, reference files and the AI catalog. Read live from the installed folder, so they cannot go stale.
en.tour.versions.d: Before updating, the panel works out the impact: which tokens went away and which of your files use them. A rollback point is recorded automatically, so there is always a way back.
en.tour.video.banner: Best watched first — everything here makes sense afterwards
en.tour.video.soon: The explainer video is on its way
en.tour.video.soon.d: The walkthrough below is enough to get started. The video appears on its own once the file lands in the design system repo.
en.tour.welcome.d: This panel is what connects the design system to your repo. Watch the short explainer first, then I'll walk you through the parts one by one.
en.ver.impact.none: No tokens or specs are removed. Safe.
en.ver.lead: See the impact first, then update. Always reversible.
en.ver.noRollback: No rollback point yet — one is recorded automatically on your first update.
en.ver.rollback.hint: Return to the previous design system version.
